scoring_justification: DFT and phonon calculations cannot be re‑executed in the verifier; agent self‑reports values. Comparison to hidden paper gold (VHS 70 meV ±30) and phonon stability condition (min freq > 0, no imaginary modes) provides verifiable correctness.

hidden_assets.purpose: VHS energy offset and phonon stability gold values
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: van Hove singularity ~70 meV above εF; no soft phonon modes.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper’s explicit statement and phonon dispersion nature.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values match the paper’s central claim and are not invented arbitrarily.

outputs.description: Electronic structure analysis results: energy offset of the van Hove singularity at the L-point relative to the Fermi level (meV), electronic density of states at the Fermi level (states/eV per formula unit), and a boolean indicating whether the singularity is present at the L-point.
Phonon dispersion results: the minimum phonon frequency (cm⁻¹) across the Brillouin zone, and a boolean indicating whether any imaginary (negative) phonon modes exist.

output_contract.notes: The checker extracts the reported VHS energy offset and compares it to the paper's reference value with a hidden tolerance; it verifies that the minimum phonon frequency is positive (dynamical stability).
